svg.title: The share among small enterprises rose in every listed country in two years, by very different amounts
svg.desc: Table: The share among small enterprises rose in every listed country in two years, by very different amounts: Share: Denmark: 37.5%, Finland: 33.5%, Germany: 23.1%, Türkiye: 6.6%, Italy: 14.2%, Poland: 5.8%, Romania: 4.1%; Change: Denmark: 202.7%, Finland: 191.9%, Germany: 138.2%, Türkiye: 32.3%, Italy: 226.4%, Poland: 157.3%, Romania: 286.0%.
